1.web: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
1.asv: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

2.web: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
2.asv: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

3.web: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
3.asv: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

4.web: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
4.asv: For my love they are my adversaries: But Igive myself untoprayer.

5.web: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
5.asv: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

6.web: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
6.asv: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.

7.web: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
7.asv: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer be turned into sin.

8.web: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
8.asv: Let his days be few; Andlet another take his office.

9.web: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
9.asv: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

10.web: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
10.asv: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.

11.web: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
11.asv: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.

12.web: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
12.asv: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.

13.web: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
13.asv: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

14.web: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
14.asv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

15.web: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
15.asv: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

16.web: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
16.asv: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay them.

17.web: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
17.asv: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

18.web: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
18.asv: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.

19.web: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
19.asv: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

20.web: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.
20.asv: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.

21.web: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
21.asv: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name’s sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;

22.web: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
22.asv: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

23.web: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
23.asv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

24.web: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
24.asv: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.

25.web: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
25.asv: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.

26.web: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
26.asv: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:

27.web: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
27.asv: That they may know that this is thy hand; That thou, Jehovah, hast done it.

28.web: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
28.asv: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.

29.web: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
29.asv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

30.web: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
30.asv: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

31.web: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
31.asv: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.
